configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Exactly the flags the gates and pins are recorded with: -O3, strict warnings, no PCH, no compiler cache. Use this for anything whose timing or bitstream is quoted.

configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.displayName: Dev: -O1 + PCH (fastest cold build and edits)
configurePresets.description: Best for editing one file or starting from nothing. Bitstreams are identical to release (verified against the pins), but never quote encode timings from this build: -O1 is slower at runtime. Do not add ccache here: a PCH-including compile is uncacheable, so ccache would sit idle (measured 342/368 uncacheable calls).

configurePresets.name: dev-cache
configurePresets.displayName: Dev: -O1 + ccache, no PCH (fastest branch/worktree switch)
configurePresets.description: Best when the same tree is rebuilt from scratch repeatedly, e.g. one worktree per agent. PCH must stay off or ccache is bypassed. Cold build is slower than dev; a warm rebuild is near-instant.
